s0401.literal: On renchen day Venus transgressed Well.
s0401.idiomatic: On renchen day Venus transgressed Well.

s0402.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "In former ages suburban sacrifices had the ancestors jointly receive offerings.
s0402.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "In former ages suburban sacrifices had the ancestors jointly receive offerings.

s0403.literal: Your subjects deliberated: as this is the first performance of suburban rites, it is fitting to sacrifice to the Supreme Ruler of August Heaven alone.
s0403.idiomatic: Your subjects deliberated: as this is the first performance of suburban rites, it is fitting to sacrifice to the Supreme Ruler of August Heaven alone.

s0404.literal: " An edict ordered implementation according to their deliberation.
s0404.idiomatic: An edict ordered implementation according to their deliberation.

s0405.literal: Because Kaifeng, Guide, and Anfeng suffered disaster last year, and Tanzhou, Chenzhou, Guiyang, and Dongping routes suffered famine — all were given relief.
s0405.idiomatic: Because Kaifeng, Guide, and Anfeng suffered disaster last year, and Tanzhou, Chenzhou, Guiyang, and Dongping routes suffered famine — all were given relief.

s0406.literal: Fifth month, dingwei day: an edict directed that for princes, imperial sons-in-law, retainers, and all appanages, all market corvée and labor levies should be shared equally with the people.
s0406.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingwei day, an edict directed that for princes, imperial sons-in-law, retainers, and all appanages, all market corvée and labor levies should be shared equally with the people.

s0407.literal: Officials were dispatched to transfer officials in Yunnan, Sichuan, Fujian, and the Two Guangs.
s0407.idiomatic: Officials were dispatched to transfer officials in Yunnan, Sichuan, Fujian, and the Two Guangs.

s0408.literal: Dadu suffered drought; envoys were dispatched bearing incense to pray for rain.
s0408.idiomatic: Dadu suffered drought; envoys were dispatched bearing incense to pray for rain.

s0409.literal: On wushen day Confucian studies intendant of Shaanxi Xiao Yan was summoned to court; the relevant office was ordered to supply him with a comfortable carriage.
s0409.idiomatic: On wushen day Confucian studies intendant of Shaanxi Xiao Yan was summoned to court; the relevant office was ordered to supply him with a comfortable carriage.

s0410.literal: On wuwu day the Rectification and Anti-Corruption Surveillance Commissions of each circuit were changed to Detailed Punishment and Observation Commissions; the secretariat and censorate were permitted to recruit persons for appointment.
s0410.idiomatic: On wuwu day the rectification and anti-corruption surveillance commissions of each circuit were changed to detailed punishment and observation commissions; the secretariat and censorate were permitted to recruit persons for appointment.

s0411.literal: The Derivation of Blessings Office was established, rank 2a.
s0411.idiomatic: The Derivation of Blessings Office was established at rank 2a.

s0412.literal: On guihai day Jupiter masked the Left Enforcer.
s0412.idiomatic: On guihai day Jupiter masked the Left Enforcer.

s0413.literal: Because of an earthquake, Pingyang was renamed Jinning and Taiyuan was renamed Jining.
s0413.idiomatic: Because of an earthquake, Pingyang was renamed Jinning and Taiyuan was renamed Jining.

s0414.literal: Hongze and Shaobo garrison farms were re-established; Henan branch secretariat grand councillor Asan was ordered to oversee the matter.
s0414.idiomatic: Hongze and Shaobo garrison farms were re-established; Henan branch secretariat grand councillor Asan was ordered to oversee the matter.

s0415.literal: Yulin County was merged into Guizhou.
s0415.idiomatic: Yulin County was merged into Guizhou.

s0416.literal: Because Jinning and Jining had suffered disaster for successive years, thirty-five thousand ingots of notes were granted.
s0416.idiomatic: Because Jinning and Jining had suffered disaster for successive years, 35,000 ingots of notes were granted.

s0417.literal: Baoqing Route suffered famine; five thousand shi of grain were issued for relief.
s0417.idiomatic: Baoqing Route suffered famine; 5,000 shi of grain were issued for relief.

s0418.literal: Because Weinan, Liyang, and other counties in Shaanxi suffered drought last year, their field rents were remitted.
s0418.idiomatic: Because Weinan, Liyang, and other counties in Shaanxi suffered drought last year, their field rents were remitted.

s0420.literal: Sixth month, bingzi new moon: to install the crown prince, Central Secretariat Right Chancellor Dalaqan Halaqsun was dispatched to announce to the Supreme Ruler of August Heaven, and Censor-in-Chief Teguder to announce at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0420.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the bingzi new moon, to install the crown prince, central secretariat right chancellor Dalaqan Halaqsun was dispatched to announce to the Supreme Ruler of August Heaven, and censor-in-chief Teguder to announce at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0421.literal: On gengchen day Prince Deshou was installed as crown prince; an edict announced this throughout the realm.
s0421.idiomatic: On gengchen day Prince Deshou was installed as crown prince; an edict announced this throughout the realm.

s0422.literal: Silk was granted to the aged — one bolt to those eighty years old, two bolts to those ninety.
s0422.idiomatic: Silk was granted to the aged — one bolt to those 80 years old, two bolts to those 90.

s0423.literal: Filial sons and obedient grandsons fit for government service were appointed according to their talents.
s0423.idiomatic: Filial sons and obedient grandsons fit for government service were appointed according to their talents.

s0424.literal: Those whose parents were seventy with no other attendant were transferred to nearby posts;
s0424.idiomatic: Those whose parents were 70 with no other attendant were transferred to nearby posts;

s0425.literal: officials outside the capital of fifth rank and below all had one rank of seniority reduced.
s0425.idiomatic: officials outside the capital of fifth rank and below all had one rank of seniority reduced.

s0426.literal: Prisoners detained five years or more everywhere, aside from those guilty of treason and murder, and those whose cases could not be decided despite doubt, were released.
s0426.idiomatic: Prisoners detained five years or more everywhere, aside from those guilty of treason and murder and those whose cases could not be decided despite doubt, were released.

s0427.literal: Persons exiled to distant regions were transferred inward as appropriate.
s0427.idiomatic: Persons exiled to distant regions were transferred inward as appropriate.

s0428.literal: On jiawu day torrential rain in Tongchuan caused the river to overflow, inundating commoners' dwellings; many drowned; an edict ordered the relevant office to grant one month's grain and remit field rent.
s0428.idiomatic: On jiawu day torrential rain in Tongchuan caused the river to overflow, inundating commoners' dwellings; many drowned; an edict ordered the relevant office to grant one month's grain and remit field rent.

s0429.literal: Because Qiongzhou had repeatedly suffered rebel raids, and Longxing, Fuzhou, Linjiang, and other routes suffered flooding, and Kaifeng suffered rain disaster — one month's grain was granted to each.
s0429.idiomatic: Because Qiongzhou had repeatedly suffered rebel raids, and Longxing, Fuzhou, Linjiang, and other routes suffered flooding, and Kaifeng suffered rain disaster — one month's grain was granted to each.

s0430.literal: Huanzhou and Xuande suffered hail; Fengxiang and Fufeng suffered drought; Tong, Tai, Jinghai, and Wuqing suffered locusts.
s0430.idiomatic: Huanzhou and Xuande suffered hail; Fengxiang and Fufeng suffered drought; Tong, Tai, Jinghai, and Wuqing suffered locusts.

s0431.literal: Autumn, seventh month, yisi new moon: brewing was forbidden in Jinning, Jining, and Datong; half of this year's commercial tax in Jinning and Jining was remitted.
s0431.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the yisi new moon, brewing was forbidden in Jinning, Jining, and Datong; half of this year's commercial tax in Jinning and Jining was remitted.

s0432.literal: On bingwu day Mars transgressed Root.
s0432.idiomatic: On bingwu day Mars transgressed Root.

s0433.literal: On xinhai day a suburban altar was built south of Lizheng and Wenming gates at the bing position; a Suburban Sacrifice Office was established, with one director and one vice director, three grand invocators, two directors of rites, one director of music, and two keepers of the ritual objects storehouse.
s0433.idiomatic: On xinhai day a suburban altar was built south of Lizheng and Wenming gates at the bing position; a Suburban Sacrifice Office was established with one director and one vice director, three grand invocators, two directors of rites, one director of music, and two keepers of the ritual objects storehouse.

s0434.literal: On guichou day Blackwater New City was made Jing'an Route.
s0434.idiomatic: On guichou day Blackwater New City was made Jing'an Route.

s0435.literal: The Secretariat Directorate for Palace Library and the Palace Guard Office were both promoted to rank 3a; the Fujian Mongol Script Intendant Office and the Medical Intendant Office were abolished.
s0435.idiomatic: The secretariat directorate for the palace library and the Palace Guard Office were both promoted to rank 3a; the Fujian Mongol script intendant office and the medical intendant office were abolished.

s0436.literal: Prince of Anxi Ananda's son Yuelu Tiemuer was granted two thousand ingots of notes.
s0436.idiomatic: Prince of Anxi Ananda's son Yuelu Tiemuer was granted 2,000 ingots of notes.

s0437.literal: On jiayin day Venus passed through heaven.
s0437.idiomatic: On jiayin day Venus passed through heaven.

s0438.literal: On gengshen day the Treasury Directorate was promoted to the Treasury Office.
s0438.idiomatic: On gengshen day the Treasury Directorate was promoted to the Treasury Office.

s0439.literal: On renxu day one thousand taels of gold, seventy-five thousand taels of silver, and one hundred thirty thousand ingots of notes were granted to Empress Dowager Xingsheng and close-attendant ministers, who went to reside at Huaizhou.
s0439.idiomatic: On renxu day 1,000 taels of gold, 75,000 taels of silver, and 130,000 ingots of notes were granted to Empress Dowager Xingsheng and close-attendant ministers, who went to reside at Huaizhou.

s0440.literal: The princely establishment officials of the Prince of Huaining were re-established.
s0440.idiomatic: The princely establishment officials of the Prince of Huaining were re-established.

s0441.literal: Prince of Weiyuan Yuemuhuer was granted ten thousand ingots of notes; eleven thousand two hundred ingots were granted for the twelve relay stations from Dadu to Shangdu.
s0441.idiomatic: Prince of Weiyuan Yuemuhuer was granted 10,000 ingots of notes; 11,200 ingots were granted for the 12 relay stations from Dadu to Shangdu.

s0442.literal: On dingmao day Mars transgressed Room.
s0442.idiomatic: On dingmao day Mars transgressed Room.

s0443.literal: Grand Minister of Works Duan Zhen and Central Secretariat Right Vice Chancellor Badumasin were both made central secretariat grand councillors; Associate Administrator Khorlamanzi was made right vice chancellor; Associate Administrator Mirhoja was made left vice chancellor; and Secretariat Deliberator Yesi Bo was made associate administrator.
s0443.idiomatic: Grand minister of works Duan Zhen and central secretariat right vice chancellor Badumasin were both made central secretariat grand councillors; associate administrator Khorlamanzi was made right vice chancellor; associate administrator Mirhoja was made left vice chancellor; and secretariat deliberator Yesi Bo was made associate administrator.

s0444.literal: Five months' grain was granted to the Qirgis people under Toqtoghan's command.
s0444.idiomatic: Five months' grain was granted to the Qirgis people under Toqtoghan's command.

s0445.literal: The Yusha River in Mianyang overflowed, the Xihua River in Chen Prefecture overflowed, and Yizhou suffered flooding; four thousand shi of grain were issued for relief.
s0445.idiomatic: The Yusha River in Mianyang overflowed, the Xihua River in Chen Prefecture overflowed, and Yizhou suffered flooding; 4,000 shi of grain were issued for relief.

s0446.literal: Taixing and Jiangdu in Yangzhou and Shanyang in Huai'an suffered flooding; more than nine thousand shi of field rent was remitted.
s0446.idiomatic: Taixing and Jiangdu in Yangzhou and Shanyang in Huai'an suffered flooding; more than 9,000 shi of field rent was remitted.

s0447.literal: Tan, Chen, Heng, Lei, Xia, Teng, Yi, and Ninghai prefectures suffered famine; fifty-one thousand six hundred shi of grain were sold at reduced prices.
s0447.idiomatic: Tan, Chen, Heng, Lei, Xia, Teng, Yi, and Ninghai prefectures suffered famine; 51,600 shi of grain were sold at reduced prices.

s0448.literal: Eighth month, yihai new moon: redundant posts in the Lekesun office were cut.
s0448.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the yihai new moon, redundant posts in the Lekesun office were cut.

s0449.literal: Lekesun exclusively managed fodder and grain; initially there were only a few men, but later persons of various ranks were added, until the staff became excessively numerous.
s0449.idiomatic: Lekesun exclusively managed fodder and grain; initially there were only a few men, but later persons of various ranks were added until the staff became excessively numerous.

s0450.literal: At this time twelve posts remained; the rest were all abolished.
s0450.idiomatic: At this time 12 posts remained; the rest were all abolished.

s0451.literal: On bingzi day one thousand four hundred seventy-odd shi of grain were granted to Dadu relay-station households.
s0451.idiomatic: On bingzi day more than 1,470 shi of grain were granted to Dadu relay-station households.

s0452.literal: On dingchou day sweeping households of the Confucius forest temple at Qufu were granted fifty qing of Imperial Exquisite Office fields to supply annual sacrifices.
s0452.idiomatic: On dingchou day sweeping households of the Confucius forest temple at Qufu were granted 50 qing of Imperial Exquisite Office fields to supply annual sacrifices.

s0453.literal: On jimao day, because Jining again had poor harvests, prohibitions on mountains, marshes, and rivers were lifted, allowing the people to gather and hunt.
s0453.idiomatic: On jimao day, because Jining again had poor harvests, prohibitions on mountains, marshes, and rivers were lifted, allowing the people to gather and hunt.

s0454.literal: Grand Master of Sacrifices Choulü and Hanlin Academy Grand Academician Jin Dejin were ordered to sacrifice to the stars at the Bureau of Astronomy.
s0454.idiomatic: Grand master of sacrifices Choulü and Hanlin Academy grand academician Jin Dejin were ordered to sacrifice to the stars at the Bureau of Astronomy.

s0455.literal: On xinsi day the moon transgressed the Eastern Rampart.
s0455.idiomatic: On xinsi day the moon transgressed the Eastern Rampart.

s0456.literal: On bingxu day the merchant Shanghu Taqi presented precious goods in tribute; sixty thousand ingots of notes were granted as payment.
s0456.idiomatic: On bingxu day the merchant Shanghu Taqi presented precious goods in tribute; 60,000 ingots of notes were granted as payment.

s0457.literal: On guisi day the Bureau of Fiscal Affairs was re-established.
s0457.idiomatic: On guisi day the Bureau of Fiscal Affairs was re-established.

s0458.literal: On yiwei day Mars transgressed Heavenly River.
s0458.idiomatic: On yiwei day Mars transgressed Heavenly River.

s0459.literal: Prince of Ningyuan Kuokuochu was granted ten thousand ingots of notes, and thirty thousand ingots to his subjects.
s0459.idiomatic: Prince of Ningyuan Kuokuochu was granted 10,000 ingots of notes, and 30,000 ingots to his subjects.

s0460.literal: That month Zhuozhou, Dong'an Prefecture, Hejian, and Jiaxing suffered locusts; Xiang Prefecture, Rong Prefecture, and Liuzhou suffered drought; Guide and Chen Prefecture suffered river overflow; Daming suffered great flooding; Yangzhou suffered famine.
s0460.idiomatic: That month Zhuozhou, Dong'an Prefecture, Hejian, and Jiaxing suffered locusts; Xiang Prefecture, Rong Prefecture, and Liuzhou suffered drought; Guide and Chen Prefecture suffered river overflow; Daming suffered great flooding; Yangzhou suffered famine.

s0461.literal: Ninth month, wushen day, the Emperor's birthday: the imperial carriage halted at Shouning Palace and received court congratulations.
s0461.idiomatic: On wushen day in the ninth month, the Emperor's birthday, the imperial carriage halted at Shouning Palace and received court congratulations.

s0462.literal: On dingsi day Mars transgressed Dipper.
s0462.idiomatic: On dingsi day Mars transgressed Dipper.

s0463.literal: On gengshen day the imperial carriage returned from the Upper Capital.
s0463.idiomatic: On gengshen day the imperial carriage returned from the Upper Capital.

s0464.literal: Prince of Weiwu and Xining Chuebo's subjects were granted thirty thousand ingots of notes.
s0464.idiomatic: Prince of Weiwu and Xining Chuebo's subjects were granted 30,000 ingots of notes.

s0465.literal: Winter, tenth month, dingchou new moon: the Directorate of Waterways was promoted to rank 3a.
s0465.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the dingchou new moon, the directorate of waterways was promoted to rank 3a.

s0466.literal: On xinsi day sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0466.idiomatic: On xinsi day sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0467.literal: On bingxu day Venus passed through heaven.
s0467.idiomatic: On bingxu day Venus passed through heaven.

s0468.literal: On jichou day an edict ordered southern-army troops and natives in the Two Guangs to garrison jointly.
s0468.idiomatic: On jichou day an edict ordered southern-army troops and natives in the Two Guangs to garrison jointly.

s0469.literal: On gengyin day imperial son-in-law Atipeibuhua returned from Duwa; fifty taels of silver and two hundred ingots of notes were granted.
s0469.idiomatic: On gengyin day imperial son-in-law Atipeibuhua returned from Duwa; 50 taels of silver and 200 ingots of notes were granted.

s0470.literal: On yiwei day the Emperor instructed central secretariat, privy council, and censorate officials, saying: "Secretariat affairs are to be overseen in total by Right Chancellor Halaqsun Dalaqan; from now on anyone appointed without joint deliberation with Dalaqan is to be dismissed.
s0470.idiomatic: On yiwei day the Emperor instructed central secretariat, privy council, and censorate officials, saying, "Secretariat affairs are to be overseen in total by right chancellor Halaqsun Dalaqan; from now on anyone appointed without joint deliberation with Dalaqan is to be dismissed.

s0471.literal: " On wuxu day an edict directed that garrison farms at Shaobo, Hongze, and elsewhere seized by powerful families should all pay field rent.
s0471.idiomatic: On wuxu day an edict directed that garrison farms at Shaobo, Hongze, and elsewhere seized by powerful families should all pay field rent.

s0472.literal: On xinchou day the Detailed Punishment and Observation Commissions were again changed to Rectification and Anti-Corruption Surveillance Commissions.
s0472.idiomatic: On xinchou day the detailed punishment and observation commissions were again changed to rectification and anti-corruption surveillance commissions.

s0473.literal: Changzhou monk registrar Lin Qiyou falsely registered two hundred eighty qing of official fields as his own property and donated them to Hexi Monastery; an edict ordered the people recruited to cultivate them and pay rent to the government.
s0473.idiomatic: Changzhou monk registrar Lin Qiyou falsely registered 280 qing of official fields as his own property and donated them to Hexi Monastery; an edict ordered the people recruited to cultivate them and pay rent to the government.

s0474.literal: Censorate officials requested increased salaries for officials; they were ordered to deliberate jointly with the central secretariat and report.
s0474.idiomatic: Censorate officials requested increased salaries for officials; they were ordered to deliberate jointly with the central secretariat and report.

s0475.literal: Land in the Two Huai regions seized by powerful families was registered; they were ordered to pay rent and levies.
s0475.idiomatic: Land in the Two Huai regions seized by powerful families was registered; they were ordered to pay rent and levies.

s0476.literal: King Chen Yiji of Annam was granted five hundred qing of land in Huguang.
s0476.idiomatic: King Chen Yiji of Annam was granted 500 qing of land in Huguang.

s0477.literal: Princes Hu'alachu and Sirigis came to congratulate the installation of the crown prince; notes, clothing, bows, and arrows were granted in varying amounts.
s0477.idiomatic: Princes Hu'alachu and Sirigis came to congratulate the installation of the crown prince; notes, clothing, bows, and arrows were granted in varying amounts.

s0478.literal: Eleventh month, dingwei day: ten thousand ingots of notes were granted to the Yunnan branch secretariat, to be used together with cowrie shells; cowrie not native to the region was to be treated like counterfeit notes.
s0478.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingwei day, 10,000 ingots of notes were granted to the Yunnan branch secretariat to be used together with cowrie shells; cowrie not native to the region was to be treated like counterfeit notes.

s0479.literal: Relay vouchers of princes and imperial consorts were confiscated.
s0479.idiomatic: Relay vouchers of princes and imperial consorts were confiscated.

s0480.literal: The Dadu Southern City Patrol Office was established.
s0480.idiomatic: The Dadu Southern City Patrol Office was established.

s0481.literal: Huang Shengxu sent his followers to present local products and requested restoration of his son's office; the Emperor did not approve, saying: "Shengxu is unreliable and not to be trusted; if he repents and comes in person, then office may be obtained.
s0481.idiomatic: Huang Shengxu sent his followers to present local products and requested restoration of his son's office; the Emperor did not approve, saying, "Shengxu is unreliable and not to be trusted; if he repents and comes in person, then office may be obtained.

s0482.literal: " An edict granted clothing and sent them away.
s0482.idiomatic: An edict granted clothing and sent them away.

s0483.literal: Because Jining suffered an earthquake last year and relay-station households were impoverished, an edict forbade princes and imperial sons-in-law from sending envoys on their own authority to use the relay system.
s0483.idiomatic: Because Jining suffered an earthquake last year and relay-station households were impoverished, an edict forbade princes and imperial sons-in-law from sending envoys on their own authority to use the relay system.

s0484.literal: Yunnan garrison farming was re-established; Bayanchar was ordered to supervise the matter.
s0484.idiomatic: Yunnan garrison farming was re-established; Bayanchar was ordered to supervise the matter.

s0485.literal: Five ingots of notes were granted to each household in Datong whose members garrisoning in Sichuan had been crushed to death in the earthquake at their homes.
s0485.idiomatic: Five ingots of notes were granted to each household in Datong whose members garrisoning in Sichuan had been crushed to death in the earthquake at their homes.

s0486.literal: On gengxu day Jupiter, Venus, and Saturn gathered at Rooftop.
s0486.idiomatic: On gengxu day Jupiter, Venus, and Saturn gathered at Rooftop.

s0487.literal: On guichou day Jupiter transgressed Rooftop.
s0487.idiomatic: On guichou day Jupiter transgressed Rooftop.

s0488.literal: On bingyin day Jupiter was visible by day.
s0488.idiomatic: On bingyin day Jupiter was visible by day.

s0489.literal: On gengwu day the Supreme Ruler of August Heaven was sacrificed to at the southern suburb; victims were one horse, one azure calf, and nine each of sheep, pigs, and deer; the civil dance was called "Dance of Honoring Virtue," and the martial dance "Dance of Establishing Merit."
s0489.idiomatic: On gengwu day the Supreme Ruler of August Heaven was sacrificed to at the southern suburb; victims were one horse, one azure calf, and nine each of sheep, pigs, and deer; the civil dance was called "Dance of Honoring Virtue," and the martial dance "Dance of Establishing Merit."

s0490.literal: Acting Grand Marshal Right Chancellor Halaqsun, Left Chancellor Ahutai, and Censor-in-Chief Teguder served as the three offering officers.
s0490.idiomatic: Acting grand marshal right chancellor Halaqsun, left chancellor Ahutai, and censor-in-chief Teguder served as the three offering officers.

s0491.literal: On renshen day Venus passed through heaven.
s0491.idiomatic: On renshen day Venus passed through heaven.

s0492.literal: Twelfth month, yihai day: Jining Route was granted ten thousand ingots of notes and ten thousand salt certificates to supply annual expenses.
s0492.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yihai day, Jining Route was granted 10,000 ingots of notes and 10,000 salt certificates to supply annual expenses.

s0493.literal: On bingzi day Venus transgressed the Western Rampart.
s0493.idiomatic: On bingzi day Venus transgressed the Western Rampart.

s0495.literal: On gengyin day Mars transgressed the Mound Wall Formation.
s0495.idiomatic: On gengyin day Mars transgressed the Mound Wall Formation.

s0497.literal: On jihai day Mercury transgressed Establishing Star.
s0497.idiomatic: On jihai day Mercury transgressed Establishing Star.

s0498.literal: Tenth year, spring, first month, renyin new moon: King Wang Ju of Koryo dispatched envoys to present local products in tribute.
s0498.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the tenth year, on the renyin new moon, King Wang Ju of Koryo dispatched envoys to present local products in tribute.

s0499.literal: On jiachen day an edict directed inquiry into the ritual norms and domestic and foreign governance of Empress Zhuangsheng, Empress Zhaorui Shunsheng, and Empress Huiren Yusheng, for compilation and record.
s0499.idiomatic: On jiachen day an edict directed inquiry into the ritual norms and domestic and foreign governance of Empress Zhuangsheng, Empress Zhaorui Shunsheng, and Empress Huiren Yusheng, for compilation and record.

s0500.literal: On bingwu day the transport canals at Wusong River and other places were dredged.
s0500.idiomatic: On bingwu day the transport canals at Wusong River and other places were dredged.
